title: Hold a licence for a radiation source
what: Use, possess, sell or otherwise deal with a radiation source only under a licence.

sources.title: Radiation Protection Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not manufacture, sell, acquire, possess, use, store, transport, dispose of or otherwise deal with a radiation source other than in accordance with a licence authorising the person to do so
